The '''IBC Arcology''' was a massive pyramidal structure on [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]] owned by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]].

== Description ==
The IBC Arcology was an impossibly huge step pyramid that rose [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the surface of [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]]. Each step of the pyramid corresponded to a level, of which there was seven. [[Droid/Legends|Droids]] were programmed to find their way around all the levels, but a person could spend years memorizing the access codes and charts and still get lost. It was said that if someone ventured to the wrong level, they could spend their entire life wandering and would never be able get back where they started. [[Turbolift/Legends|Turbolifts]] were used to reach each level, but there were also secret tunnels, [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] tubes, and ventilation shafts that could be used to bypass special clearances and fees. Each level corresponded to a specific function and was color-coded.<ref name=":0">''[[Boba Fett: Maze of Deception]]''</ref>

=== Level One ===
Level One was located at the apex of the pyramid and was the smallest level. The docking zone and customs terminals were located here. Infrared rays disinfected incoming ships and visitors to keep the Arcology immaculate. A large [[holosign]] displayed the [[Three Statutes of Aargau]] above the Central Customs console. Visitors were required to present a [[Retinal scan/Legends|retinal scan]] and their [[filocard]] as proof of their investment. The carrying of weapons by non-citizens was illegal and strictly enforced by [[S-EP1 security droid|S-EP1 security droids]] and [[IG-series/Legends|IG Assassin droids]]. Every visitor was checked in and out by security, and first-time visitors were only cleared to visit levels one through three. Level One's color-code was red.<ref name=":0" />

=== Level Two ===
Level Two was substantially larger than Level One. It consisted of a large central area that branched off into hundreds of tunnels. These tunnels contained thousands of vaults, treasuries, and off-world banks such as the [[First Royal Bank of M'haeli]], [[Bothan Independent Treasury]], [[N'zoth]] Banks, [[Registered Bank of Ammuud]], and the [[InterGalactic Bank of Kuat]]. Aargau was the bank of the galaxy, and there was enough precious metals in the Arcology's vaults to outfit an entire army a thousand times over. Level Two's color-code was green.<ref name=":0" />

=== Level Three ===
Level Three held more banks and vaults. It was also considered the tech support level. Its color-code was yellow.<ref name=":0" /> 

=== Level Four ===
Level Four was dedicated to habitation and lodging.<ref name=":0" />

=== Level Five ===
Level Five had stores to buy supplies from.<ref name=":0" />

=== Level Six ===
Level Six was dedicated to entertainment and recreational facilities. There was an area above Level Seven that was considered the sanitation level.<ref name=":0" />

=== Level Seven ===
Level Seven was the actual surface of Aargau. It contained a sprawling city known as the [[Aargau Undercity|Undercity]]. The bulk of the Arcology pyramid left the Undercity in perpetual darkness and artificial light. The Undercity could be accessed by turbolift with the proper clearance and credits, but most beings preferred the thousands of illegal and forgotten routes. It consisted of ruined building and roads filled with market stalls and trash. The gap between the ground and the Undercity's ceiling was occupied by repulsor tubes, [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]], [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bikes]], [[Metrocab Robo-Hack Landspeeder|robo-hacks]], and [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]]. The Undercity was considered more crowded than [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Its [[Black market/Legends|black market]] thrived as the [[Bank of Aargau/Legends|Bank of Aargau]] encouraged free trade, and accepted merchants and traders from anywhere in the galaxy. These beings were attracted to the fortunes that could be made from trading currency. [[Smuggler/Legends|Smugglers]] traded [[Gold/Legends|gold]], [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], data, droids, jewels, weapons, ships, and information. Black market money changers lured unsuspecting visitors down to the Undercity to steal their credits with illegal banking droids. Despite Aargau's weapon law, every being in the Undercity was armed. Most weren't authorized citizens, though forged citizenship documentation could be purchased. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] operated a gambling den built in the shape of a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragon]] head in the Undercity.<ref name=":0" />      

== History ==
The site of the IBC Arcology pyramid was home to the ruins of a vast city constructed by the original natives of Aargau, likely the [[Sharu/Legends|Sharu]]<ref>''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>, millions of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] ago. The pyramid grew out of the city, layer by layer, level by level, over thousands of years.<ref name=":0" /> 

When the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] took control of Aargau, the pyramid dominated a large part of the habitable portion of the planet so the IBC could better organize and control the planet's populace. The Arcology held the vaults of the Bank of Aargau, a subsidiary of the IBC that served as the governing body of Aargau and as the primary bank of the galaxy.<ref name=":0" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] inspection team linked [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|Hailfire droids]] captured at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] to manufacturing plants within the IBC Arcology. When the inspection team disappeared, the Republic breached Aargau's neutrality status by posting armed [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] guards in the Arcology. The Republic claimed these troops were in the Arcology to guard the Republic's financial assets that were stores in the Arcology's vaults. The [[Aargau Executive Board]] threatened to seceded in protest of what they perceived to be an illegal occupation.<ref> "[[CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:2:14 Edition]]" — [[Star Wars Insider 65|''Star Wars Insider'' 65]]</ref> Amid these tensions, IBC [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] avoided the prying eyes of the clones by meeting with a [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|representative]] of Jabba the Hutt in the Arcology Undercity to negotiate for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts']] financial support to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] cause. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] [[Mission to Aargau|visited]] the IBC Arcology during these events to recover the fortune [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] had left for his son in a [[InterGalactic Bank of Kuat|bank]] [[High-Yield Universal Institutional Savings Account|account]].<ref name=":0" />
